item.title: Worldview Weekly — September 24, 2026
item.description: Worldview Weekly for September twenty-fourth, twenty twenty-six. This week’s issue is about systems that look simple from far away and become much more complicated once we ask where the costs, incentives, and adaptation actually sit. A tariff is not only a tax on an import. It changes supplier relationships across several countries at once. An AI data center is not only a building full of servers. It is also a new electricity customer, a land user, a water user, and sometimes a political constituency. A geopolitical bloc is not necessarily an alliance, but it can still create options for its members. A new scientific idea does not have to carry the mechanism of its original field with it; so…
